title: OBC v3 On-Chain Memo
description: Schema for the OBC v3 JSON memo stored in a Solana transaction, signed by the publisher wallet, in an instruction of the p-memo program (Memo4c2pN8afCj432Lb7RMVKi9PbQnnW7ewFFaV3oAH) or, for records published before the switch, SPL Memo (MemoSq4gqABAXKb96qnH8TysNcWxMyWCqXgDLGmfcHr). The memo carries no storage location: verifiers resolve it through the publisher's location account (location-schema.json). The memo JSON must be at most 950 bytes (UTF-8).

v.description: OBC standard version. Always '3' for this standard.

h.description: SHA-256 hex digest (lowercase, 64 chars) of the exact off-chain file bytes. The file is stored as {base}/{h}.json.

d.description: Document id, the same for every version of one source document, at most 128 UTF-8 bytes. Private mode (default): lowercase hex of HMAC-SHA256(K, '{orgId}\n{sourceSystem}\n{sourceKey}'). Public mode: '{orgId}:{sourceSystem}:{sourceKey}'. sourceSystem is trimmed and lowercased; sourceKey is '{SourceSystemDocumentId}/{DocumentJournalId}', with '#1', '#2', ... appended in id order when several journals of one document share a DocumentJournalId.

n.description: Version number, starting at 1 and incremented by 1 per version.

p.description: h of the previous version (n - 1). Required when n > 1, absent when n = 1.

a.description: Optional HTTPS location hint. Never required for verification.

propertyNames.description: Single-letter keys and keys starting with '_' are reserved for the standard. Tenant fields must not use them.

additionalProperties.description: Optional tenant-configured on-chain fields. Public and permanent.
